why.rareearth: Nd and La are hard to separate; China does most of it
why.magrec: Magnet scrap holds Nd and Dy that are rarely recovered
why.reecoal: Coal waste holds rare earths at low levels
why.lithium: Lithium sits in brines full of sodium
why.tmdiss: Recycled cathode leach mixes Ni, Co and Mn
why.phosphate: Phosphate in farm runoff feeds algae blooms
why.mousy: Mousy wine can’t be fixed once it forms
why.rebar: Road salt rusts the steel inside concrete
why.tfa: The smallest forever chemical slips through water filters
why.chalco: Most copper ore resists cheap leaching
why.smoke: Wildfire smoke ruins wine; today’s fix strips flavor
why.selenate: Selenium in mine water looks like sulfate
why.sulfur: One stubborn sulfur molecule stays in diesel
why.hardener: Epoxy wind blades can’t be recycled
why.shortpfas: Short-chain PFAS pass today’s water filters
why.coolant: Immersion fluids are PFAS or flammable
why.lignin: Lignin waste is burned, not turned into chemicals
why.antiscale: Scale clogs limestone electrolysis at pH 13–14
why.ammonium: Ammonium probes are fooled by potassium

why.tmah: Chip fabs dump toxic TMAH developer
why.xenon: Xenon is rare and costly to recover from air
why.femob: Hydrogen from rock stalls when iron stays locked
why.pgmwater: Oilfield water carries traces of platinum metals
why.cmpchel: Copper polishing slurries need cleaner chelators
why.pucat: PU foam waste is hard to break back down
why.ionomer: AEM electrolyzers lose their ionomer fast
